note: P-D-2016-44173-aa1c9913, 22 A4 sheets (595x842), running header 'Team # 44173 ... Page N of 22' so printed page = PDF page, no offset; page 1 is the official summary sheet, page 2 the contents, body pages 3-22. The layout pass measures 32 regions on 15 pages and every one is an exhibit: no exclusion. Fourteen regions carry a printed caption, and between them they print twenty figure numbers, because five regions are pairs or triples of separately captioned panels fused into one measured cluster (Figures 3+4, 5+6, 9+10+11, 12+13, 14+15). The other eighteen regions are uncaptioned plates: the RBF architecture diagram (p12), the confusion matrix pasted as an image (p13), the state-transition schematic (p15), three validation plates (p16) and the parameter sweeps of 5.3.2 and 5.4 (p18 r1-r4, p19 r1-r5, p20 r1-r3). There are NO tables: the paper prints no 'Table N' caption anywhere, and the one confusion matrix is a raster image whose rows cannot be counted from the vector layer, so it is recorded as a figure of family table-as-figure. What the census turns on: the numbering is broken in two directions. Only Figures 1, 14 and 15 are cited by number at all, and the Figure 14/15 sentences are in 3.3 Prediction talking about media trends, while those two panels sweep the immune probability. The other two numbered pointers miss their art too - 'result in Figure5' on page 7 describes the lambda-1 sweep drawn on page 8 as Figures 9-11, and 'shown in figure 3' on page 16 describes the Facebook validation plates, reusing the number of the 1850 historical chart ten pages earlier. Caption side is uniform but for Figure 17, the only caption printed above its art. Graphically the paper is three softwares stacked: MATLAB SIR runs with black 'X: .. Y: ..' cursor crosses (Figures 1 style axes 'the rate of three node' against 'time/days', several carrying an unused -20 lower y limit), two Excel charts with missing axis titles (Figure 16's key sits below the frame, Figure 17's moving-average legend above it), and fifteen spreadsheet-style plate plots with dotted grids whose x axis is 't' and whose y axis is 'S(t)', 'I(t)' or 'R(t)' (p16 r1-r3, p18 r1-r4, p19 r1-r5, p20 r1-r3).
rules: 图注编号只有一种写法:20 个编号全排成 "Figure 1:" 到 "Figure 20:" 的冒号式,没有一个用句点、没有一个用 "Fig."、没有一个用大写 "FIGURE";字号与正文同号、不加粗。没有一张编号表:全文没有任何 "Table N" 图注,唯一的表(第 13 页那个混淆矩阵)是贴成图片的,正文两次都只写 "given in table"/"the results is given in table",前面没有号 [caption.numbering]
图注位置只有一处例外:其余 19 个编号全部印在图形下沿,唯独第 10 页顶端的 "Figure 17: Change of The Proportion of Daily Contact Rate" 印在图形上沿——图注占住页首那一行,柱状图挂在它下面,正文从图下方接着写;18 张无注展品(strip 图)则根本没有图注,连 "图" 字都没印 [caption.position]

正文指图只有四种印刷体:带空格的 "Figure 1"、不带空格的 "Figure5"/"Figure14"/"Figure15"、小写的 "figure 3",以及大量完全不给编号的指向("as bellow"/"the pictures of"/"from pictures below"/"as follows"/"The figure shows that");20 个编号里只有 1、14、15 被正文按号指到,而按号指到的两句(第 8 页的 Figure14、Figure15)说的是媒介趋势、画的却是第 9 页那两张免疫概率图 [mention.style]

编号与图形的对应关系是坏的,而且坏在两个方向:第 7 页 "we can find the result in Figure5" 讲的是热节点接触率扫描,真正的图是第 8 页的 Figure 9/10/11(领先量 −1 页,指认晚于图形);第 16 页 "shown in figure 3" 讲的是 5.3.1 的 Facebook 验证三张图," 而 3 号是第 6 页那张 1850 年历史曲线(领先量 −10 页),等于把 3 号用了两次;第 8 页的 Figure14/Figure15 反过来领先图形 1 页 [mention.first_page]
一张图注管两块画:第 6 页上下两排、第 8 页一排三块与一排两块、第 9 页一排两块,共 5 个被测区域各压着两到三张各自带坐标轴、各自带图例框的独立 MATLAB 子图,图注一块一块印在整排下面,于是 14 个有注区域印出了 20 个编号 [geometry.panel_count]

图例框位置随软件走,不随论文走:MATLAB 图例一律框内(左上或右上),Excel 的两张例外——第 9 页的媒介图把图例做成横轴下方一行无框图例键("online/mobile"、"laptop/computer"、"TV"、"newspaper"、"radio"),第 10 页的柱状图把两行图例印在框外上沿(五个实线键加五个 "2 per. Mov. Avg." 虚线键,十项管五个类别);第 5 页那张网络图的键印在框外右侧,用符号分状态 [geometry.legend]
